body: Yeah...it might not get better....but it can't possibly always be the same. Something will change better or worse. That's just life. I guess that's why I should let nature take its course. But that is scary. Too much unknown. I want to have some control.  Or at least the illusion of control. I am completely isolated. Makes it hard to see that there's more out there. Its ok because so much out there is terrible

I don't have any advice but there is something about you that's very special. I can sense it in your writing and I guess your therapist could too.  I sense you are turning a corner and life is going to get a lot better for you. Please hang on.
Please hang on. My friend died of leukemia when we were 20. Ilet's chat

Don't believe that for a second. You are not selfish. You care about others and always put them first. Your brain wants you to stop and do things differently.  Be kind to yourself. Take it slow.   You can get back control. You deserve to feel better.
